## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible problem, the change and any linked issue.

## Validation

List checks actually run, their results and anything that remains untested. For a behavioral fix, describe the failing-first regression test. For UI changes, include sample-data screenshots when useful.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility, dependency/protocol changes, migrations and known limitations where relevant.

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] I updated documentation affected by the change.
- [ ] The diff contains no personal sessions, exports, private media, signing keys or unreviewed logs.
- [ ] I retained relevant upstream license notices.
